newsitem.title: JAPAN: Gajoen Kanko cuts number of new shares.
newsitem.headline: Gajoen Kanko cuts number of new shares.

text.p: Hotel operator Gajoen Kanko KK said on Friday that it had reduced the number of new shares it plans to issue next March to 28.29 million from a previously scheduled 35.78 million.
As a result, the total number of Gajoen Kanko shares will increase to 90.56 million shares.
The new share issue was to gain funds to finance new projects and renovations of existing hotels, Gajoen said.
Gajoen Kanko shares were placed under surveillance in September after the company admitted it had unpaid taxes totalling about 13 billion yen.
